_description: OpenRouter generation log → AKSI control ID mapping. OpenRouter is a multi-provider LLM router; each generation record represents one upstream LLM call routed to a downstream provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, etc.). The finish_reason drives the primary control result; cancelled, is_byok, and usage cost produce additive flags. Provider routing (provider_name) is captured in evidence_data.provider_routed_to to surface the actual upstream provider for posture/lineage analysis.
